name: apotheke
description: A local-first technical knowledge management system.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @apotheke/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @apotheke/contracts" "npm run dev -w @apotheke/server" "npm run dev -w @apotheke/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @apotheke/contracts && npm run build -w @apotheke/server && npm run build -w @apotheke/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apotheke/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @apotheke/server && npm run typecheck -w @apotheke/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
